label: Config Group (Sync Gateway)
type: a named subset of a Sync Gateway cluster's nodes sharing common configuration, set via the bootstrap Config-Group-ID property. All nodes belong to the shared group 'default' unless assigned otherwise; a 'Homogeneous Sync Gateway Cluster' is the degenerate case of exactly one, all-encompassing, default group.
note: Deliberately not given a separate concept for 'homogeneous cluster' - the source's own three-row Key Terms table distinguishes cluster/homogeneous-cluster/config-group, but homogeneous-cluster is a special case of this mechanism, not a third structure.
